window-1.title: WigglyPaint
window-1.blurb: Every line you draw squirms and squeaks like it's alive, and you can export the whole wobbly mess as a GIF — it's the most charmingly imperfect drawing tool on the internet and I fully expect to see it in your next persona shoot's title cards.

window-2.title: Strictly Sweden — the strict list
window-2.blurb: Denna curates like you do — obsessively specific, zero filler — and this fresh Sweden deep-dive is basically a side quest itinerary waiting for you to claim it.

window-3.title: Spicy Passion Fruit Mocktail (AKA "Mockarita")
window-3.blurb: Four ingredients, but you get to char a jalapeño over open flame for smoky depth — a tiny bit of theatre for a drink that's tart, tropical, and named like it's in on the joke.

window-4.title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
window-4.blurb: This is a rental absolutely crammed with color and collected junk-with-soul, and it'll give you permission to stop leaving empty walls and just hang the thing.
